analysis.reason: 2일 연속 4% 이상 하락 후 반등 시도 중. RSI는 36.0에서 43.1로 상승했으나 여전히 중립 구간. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환 확신 부족. ADX 24.2로 추세 형성 초기 단계. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 0.91로 특별한 매수세 확인 불가. 204,500원 지지선 확인 필요.
analysis.reasonEn: Attempting a rebound after two consecutive days of over 4% decline. RSI rose from 36.0 to 43.1 but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement, but conviction for trend reversal is lacking. ADX at 24.2 indicates an early stage of trend formation. Trading volume ratio at 0.91 provides no confirmation of significant buying pressure. Support at 204,500 needs confirmation.

[Trend Position]
· Current price (222,500 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (226,300 KRW / 235,450 KRW / 252,040 KRW): Short-term bearish, mid-term bearish, long-term bearish.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 (268,746 KRW / 237,072 KRW): Mid-to-long term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (45.7%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.0→43.1): Consolidating in neutral zone, attempting to exit oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3904.6683→962.4807): Improving, potential for bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower 189,661 KRW, Middle 235,450 KRW): Approaching lower band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (204,500 KRW): Excessive decline relative to 5-day low.
· Swing Resistance (223,000 KRW): First resistance on short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day price range pattern (Consolidation): Weak trend reversal signals.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.91x): Moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Consider buying after confirmation of 204,500 KRW support.
